leads.detail: Local payload rebuild (15500/1500/2 caps) leaves ~1643 TS0601 couples from composes out of the published app.json (top: climate_sensor 414, curtain_motor 235, presence_sensor_radar 218). Users then see 'unknown device'. Owner: P3036 (publish workflow/caps) — not touched here.

leads.topic: gmail-diagnostics marked mails as nothing new
leads.detail: Interview for _TZE284_z7a2jmyy (NEO sprinkler) and mails about _TZE2841000000_8se38w3c were reported but the pipeline marked them as already handled while the couples were misrouted or dropped at publish.

leads.topic: port NEO sprinkler move to stable-v5 / bastien-home
leads.detail: Both branches still carry the NEO sprinkler mfrs on climate_sensor. Data parts (pins, BatteryMasterEngine DP11 profile, couple move) should follow; behaviour (water_valve_smart NEO branch) master first.
Still on valve_irrigation; Z2M NEO definitions differ (no DP109). Check DP map before any move.

Device Watchdog lets users switch each notification family on/off and pause alerts until a date/time. Our app could expose optional app settings for reconnect/battery/pairing notices (P3037b only added the grace/24h gate).

leads.topic: 'which driver do I pick' help page
leads.detail: TaHoma thread shows many users unsure which driver matches a device; a short mapping page (model -> driver) in docs/ or app settings would reduce wrong pairings.

Tuya Local allows polling interval 0 for devices that push their state, plus a longer keep-alive tolerance. Equivalent: make our optional periodic reads off by default for EF00 devices that report spontaneously.

leads.topic: power refresh must not touch the switch DP
leads.detail: Tuya Local fixed a bug where refreshing power readings also queried/wrote the on/off DP. Audit our plug energy refresh paths to query only metering DPs.

leads.topic: optional mode picker + flows for radar presence mode (DP51-like)
leads.detail: Expose an optional enum setting + action card for radar presence/scene mode where the DP is confirmed per model.

leads.topic: HVAC action from valve-state DP on TRVs
leads.detail: Derive heating/idle from the valve-state DP to feed a thermostat_mode/heating indicator.
Clarify invert setting: invert position vs invert direction; Tuya Local split them.
Route-discovery storms with TZ3000 plugs after removing a router. Our onNodeInit reads/configureReporting on rejoin should be spread (jitter) rather than burst.
